{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/REST-interface.md and release notes solely to document the code changes in this PR.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are secondary to the code change that introduces pruned txindex support."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to support indexing alongside block pruning.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Resolves multiple long-standing feature requests (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240) by allowing -txindex to operate on pruned nodes. Enabled by block hashes replacing file offsets in #35531, this substantially expands the utility of pruned nodes by allowing full transaction indexing and returning candidate block hashes when data has been pruned."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, src/rpc/request.cpp, and src/rest.cpp to return structured error data with pruned block hashes.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.42,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends JSON-RPC and REST error responses with structured error.data fields containing candidate block hashes. This allows programmatic callers to identify and fetch missing pruned blocks via getblockfrompeer rather than failing opaquely."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies test/functional/test_runner.py only to register the new txindex prune functional test.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The test additions specifically validate the txindex pruning feature rather than test infrastructure or framework capabilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp only to adjust startup argument validation between -txindex and -prune.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup option validation in init.cpp merely enables the index subsystem feature and does not alter shared node utilities."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
